applies_when: estimate_method=direct_survey and reliability=unknown
text_en: Survey estimate. DOSM publishes no sampling error for this figure, so a small difference between two places or two years may not be real.
text_bm: Anggaran tinjauan. DOSM tidak menerbitkan ralat persampelan bagi angka ini, maka perbezaan kecil antara dua tempat atau dua tahun mungkin tidak benar.

applies_when: indicator=pop.total or households.total
text_en: Mid-year estimate modelled by DOSM from the census; revised when the next census is processed.
text_bm: Anggaran pertengahan tahun oleh DOSM berasaskan banci; disemak semula selepas banci berikutnya.

applies_when: indicator=state_gov.revenue.nonrevenue_receipts
text_en: As recorded by the state: mostly federal grants and reimbursements, but the line can hold other receipts. It is not the federal government's own figure for what it paid.
text_bm: Seperti direkod oleh negeri: kebanyakannya pemberian dan bayaran balik persekutuan, tetapi boleh merangkumi terimaan lain. Ini bukan angka persekutuan tentang apa yang dibayarnya.

applies_when: geo in MY-14, MY-15, MY-16 and indicator starts state_gov.
text_en: The Federal Territories have no state government; public spending there is federal and is not yet placed by area.
text_bm: Wilayah Persekutuan tiada kerajaan negeri; perbelanjaan awam di sana adalah persekutuan dan belum dipetakan mengikut kawasan.

applies_when: basis=audited and geo is a state
text_en: Each year is taken from that year's own audited volume; restatements printed in later volumes are not applied (golden rule 6).
text_bm: Setiap tahun diambil daripada jilid teraudit tahun itu sendiri; nyatakan semula dalam jilid kemudian tidak digunakan.

applies_when: the state and year have an open FAIL in qa/known_fails.csv
text_en: Under check: this state's accounts for this year have an open check failure (listed in the answer). Treat the figure as provisional until it is resolved.
text_bm: Dalam semakan: akaun negeri ini bagi tahun ini mempunyai semakan yang gagal dan belum diselesaikan. Anggap angka ini sementara.

applies_when: indicator=gdp.real
text_en: Real GDP at 2015 prices. DOSM's 'Supra' (output not allocated to any state) is kept as _unallocated, so states do not add up to Malaysia without it.
text_bm: KDNK benar pada harga 2015. 'Supra' DOSM (keluaran yang tidak diagihkan kepada negeri) disimpan sebagai _unallocated.

applies_when: indicator=cpi.index
text_en: An index (2010=100) for price change within one place (Malaysia or one state) over time. It does not compare price levels between places.
text_bm: Indeks (2010=100) bagi perubahan harga dalam satu tempat (Malaysia atau satu negeri) dari masa ke masa. Ia tidak membandingkan paras harga antara tempat.

applies_when: derived per-capita of state government money
text_en: State government money only. Federal spending in the state (schools, clinics, subsidies, cash transfers) is most public money there and is not included until it can be placed by area.
text_bm: Wang kerajaan negeri sahaja. Perbelanjaan persekutuan di negeri itu (sekolah, klinik, subsidi, bantuan tunai) ialah sebahagian besar wang awam di sana dan belum dimasukkan.

applies_when: a series break falls between this row and earlier years of the same indicator
text_en: Series break: this indicator changed basis (see meta/series_break.csv), so this year cannot be compared with years before the break.
text_bm: Putus siri: asas penunjuk ini berubah (lihat meta/series_break.csv), jadi tahun ini tidak boleh dibandingkan dengan tahun sebelum putus siri.

applies_when: federal totals in the gap view
text_en: Federal spending is the audited operating spending before the transfer to the Development Fund, plus gross development spending, plus the COVID-19 Fund in 2020-2022, each from that year's own PKKP volume (Penyata Prestasi Kewangan; FY2009: Akaun Hasil Disatukan and Lampiran 2).
text_bm: Perbelanjaan persekutuan ialah perbelanjaan mengurus teraudit sebelum pindahan ke Kumpulan Wang Pembangunan, ditambah perbelanjaan pembangunan kasar dan Kumpulan Wang COVID-19 bagi 2020-2022, setiap satu daripada jilid PKKP tahun itu sendiri.

applies_when: estimate_method=direct_survey and reliability=low
text_en: Labour Force Survey figure for a parliamentary or state seat. The survey is designed to give reliable figures down to districts, not seats, and DOSM publishes no sampling error. Treat it as indicative; it is never ranked.
text_bm: Angka Survei Tenaga Buruh bagi kawasan parlimen atau DUN. Survei ini direka untuk angka yang boleh dipercayai sehingga peringkat daerah, bukan kawasan pilihan raya, dan DOSM tidak menerbitkan ralat persampelan. Anggap sebagai petunjuk sahaja; ia tidak disusun mengikut kedudukan.

applies_when: indicator starts hh_income.gross.pctile_group.
text_en: Income by percentile group (HIES). DOSM warns these figures carry larger relative standard errors than the headline mean and median, and publishes none. Treat a move in one percentile as noise unless neighbouring percentiles move with it. The 2022 Malaysia groups do not average back to the published 2022 mean (-1.4%); use the headline mean for levels.
text_bm: Pendapatan mengikut kumpulan persentil (HIES). DOSM memaklumkan angka ini mempunyai ralat piawai relatif yang lebih besar daripada purata dan penengah utama, dan tidak menerbitkannya. Anggap perubahan satu persentil sebagai hingar melainkan persentil berhampiran turut berubah. Kumpulan Malaysia 2022 tidak berpurata semula kepada purata 2022 yang diterbitkan (-1.4%); gunakan purata utama untuk paras.

applies_when: derived per employed person from compensation of employees
text_en: Derived, not a DOSM statistic: compensation of employees divided by all employed persons. The numerator counts employees only, while the denominator also counts the self-employed and unpaid family workers, so it understates the average employee's pay. It includes employers' EPF and SOCSO contributions (labour cost, not take-home pay). Use it as a series over time, not as a wage level.
text_bm: Diterbitkan, bukan statistik DOSM: pampasan pekerja dibahagi dengan semua penduduk bekerja. Pengangka hanya mengira pekerja bergaji, manakala penyebut turut mengira yang bekerja sendiri dan pekerja keluarga tanpa gaji, maka ia mengurangkan purata gaji pekerja. Ia termasuk caruman majikan KWSP dan PERKESO (kos buruh, bukan gaji bawa pulang). Gunakan sebagai siri masa, bukan paras gaji.

applies_when: the observation's L1 row is flagged (core/obs_flag.csv)
text_en: Flagged at source: this figure comes from a published row that fails its own arithmetic, is out of bounds, or repeats another area's figures exactly (see source_flags). It is kept as DOSM published it; do not use it without checking the original.
text_bm: Ditanda pada sumber: angka ini datang daripada baris terbitan yang tidak menepati aritmetiknya sendiri, di luar julat, atau mengulangi angka kawasan lain dengan tepat (lihat source_flags). Ia dikekalkan seperti diterbitkan DOSM; jangan gunakannya tanpa menyemak asal.

applies_when: RETIRED 2026-11-05 (Phase 3.3): no figure carries it; federal totals are read from each year's own PKKP volume. Kept so old answers that cite it still resolve
text_en: Audited (PKKP), taken through curated/fact_fiscal_headline.csv: the file cited is that table, and the PKKP volume and page are given only where it records them (development spending: none yet). Operating spending FY2009-2023 is read from the comparative column of the following year's volume, the same amount as the year's own volume to the ringgit (FY2009: the own volume prints the sen, .47). Phase 3 cites each year's own volume and page directly.
text_bm: Diaudit (PKKP), diambil melalui curated/fact_fiscal_headline.csv: fail yang dirujuk ialah jadual itu, dan jilid serta halaman PKKP diberi hanya jika jadual itu merekodkannya (perbelanjaan pembangunan: belum ada). Perbelanjaan mengurus TK2009-2023 dibaca daripada lajur perbandingan jilid tahun berikutnya, amaun yang sama dengan jilid tahun itu sendiri hingga ringgit (TK2009: jilid sendiri mencetak sen, .47). Fasa 3 merujuk jilid dan halaman setiap tahun secara terus.

applies_when: the PKKP volume this figure comes from is not in the L0 archive (meta/l0_archive.csv; decision D24), any basis printed in it
text_en: PDF not archived: this figure was extracted from the publisher's PDF and checked against its own printed totals, but that PDF is not in the archive (FY2020: the publisher's link is dead and no other official copy has been found; FY2015: the image-only scan is not yet identified), so its page cannot be re-checked from the archive.
text_bm: PDF tidak diarkibkan: angka ini diekstrak daripada PDF penerbit dan disemak dengan jumlah bercetaknya sendiri, tetapi PDF itu tiada dalam arkib (TK2020: pautan penerbit mati dan tiada salinan rasmi lain ditemui; TK2015: imbasan imej belum dikenal pasti), maka halamannya tidak boleh disemak semula daripada arkib.

applies_when: the observation is affected by one of our own known extraction defects (meta/extraction_defect_flag.csv)
text_en: Known extraction error of ours: this figure was read from the wrong printed line (see source_flags for the correct printed figure and page). It is not what the source published as this item. Do not use it until the re-extraction corrects it.
text_bm: Ralat pengekstrakan kami yang diketahui: angka ini dibaca daripada baris bercetak yang salah (lihat source_flags untuk angka bercetak yang betul dan halamannya). Ia bukan angka yang diterbitkan sumber bagi butiran ini. Jangan gunakannya sehingga pengekstrakan semula membetulkannya.

applies_when: indicator starts trade.
text_en: Merchandise trade as first published by DOSM. DOSM states that the most recent two months may be revised at the next release, and its 2026-11-04 release revised earlier months too (sources/dosm/README.md); the figure is the vintage cited.
text_bm: Dagangan barangan seperti diterbitkan DOSM. DOSM menyatakan dua bulan terkini boleh disemak semula pada keluaran berikutnya, dan keluaran 2026-11-04 turut menyemak bulan-bulan terdahulu (sources/dosm/README.md); angka ini ialah vintaj yang dipetik.

applies_when: indicator=credit.loans.banking_system
text_en: BNM MSB 1.18 total loans/financing of the banking system. It is not the same aggregate as loans and advances in BNM's statement of assets of the banking system (MSB 1.7), which is RM56-94 billion lower each month from 2021-07 to 2026-05; the two are not reconciled here and BNM's tables do not say which items differ.
text_bm: Jumlah pinjaman/pembiayaan sistem perbankan, BNM MSB 1.18. Ia bukan agregat yang sama dengan pinjaman dan pendahuluan dalam penyata aset sistem perbankan BNM (MSB 1.7), yang RM56-94 bilion lebih rendah setiap bulan dari 2021-07 hingga 2026-05; kedua-duanya tidak disesuaikan di sini dan jadual BNM tidak menyatakan butiran yang berbeza.

applies_when: the observation's L1 row carries leaf_total_mismatch (core/obs_flag.csv)
text_en: Printed total and its lines disagree: this vote's printed JUMLAH differs from the sum of its printed project lines in the same volume (FY2009, PKKP's older presentation). The diagnosis is in source_flags (curated/_known_extraction_defects_curated.csv): where it is 'source_documented' the source itself prints this; where 'unproven' the cause is not established; where 'ours_suspected' our extraction of the JUMLAH line is suspected, and the figure must not be used until it is re-checked against the page.
text_bm: Jumlah bercetak dan butirannya tidak sepadan: JUMLAH maksud ini berbeza daripada jumlah baris projeknya dalam jilid yang sama (TK2009). Diagnosis dalam source_flags; jika 'ours_suspected', pengekstrakan kami disyaki dan angka ini tidak boleh digunakan sehingga disemak semula.

applies_when: the edition is an Anggaran Perbelanjaan book and the period is before the book's year (vintage)
text_en: A past year as reprinted in a budget book, not as first tabled or as audited: the book restates past years to its own vote structure, so a vote that gained or lost functions since then carries the restated amount (the 2025 book's 2024 estimates differ from the 2024 estimates as tabled on the 11 votes reorganised in December 2023), and a body created later can show 0, or its predecessor's amounts, for years before it existed (check get_entity). For MOF's actuals (basis actual) the Auditor-General's figure for the same year is in PKKP (basis audited). Where they differ, both are kept as published.
text_bm: Tahun lalu seperti dicetak semula dalam buku belanjawan, bukan seperti dibentangkan atau diaudit: buku ini menyatakan semula tahun lalu mengikut struktur maksudnya sendiri. Angka Ketua Audit Negara bagi tahun yang sama ada dalam PKKP (asas teraudit).

applies_when: indicator starts federal_gov.vote.
text_en: Spending by the body that holds the vote, gross: it includes money the body pays on to others (grants to statutory bodies, states and local authorities, subsidies), and says nothing about where the money was spent. B.12 (Peruntukan kepada Kumpulan Wang Terkanun) includes the transfer to the Development Fund, which pays for development spending: operating votes plus development votes counts that money twice; for the federal total use federal_gov.expenditure.opex (before the transfer) plus federal_gov.expenditure.devex. Charged expenditure (Tanggungan: debt service, pensions, royal and judicial provisions) is held under the federal government by head (breakdown charged_head=T.xx).
text_bm: Perbelanjaan oleh badan yang memegang maksud, kasar: termasuk wang yang dibayar kepada pihak lain (geran kepada badan berkanun, negeri dan PBT, subsidi), dan tidak menunjukkan di mana wang dibelanjakan. Perbelanjaan tanggungan dipegang di bawah Kerajaan Persekutuan mengikut butiran.

applies_when: derive growth of one body's federal_gov.vote.* spending
text_en: A body's scope changes with cabinet reorganisations, sometimes without a change of name (Education lost Higher Education in 2015 and again in 2020; B.23 has held four portfolios since 2009): a large change can be a transfer of functions, not a change in spending. Compare the printed names at both ends (get_entity) before reading it as growth.
text_bm: Skop sesebuah badan berubah dengan penyusunan semula kabinet, kadangkala tanpa pertukaran nama: perubahan besar mungkin pemindahan fungsi, bukan perubahan perbelanjaan. Bandingkan nama bercetak di kedua-dua hujung (get_entity).

applies_when: any fact_money_flow row
text_en: A flow is money the payer's audited accounts show moving to a recipient (here the federal grants to governments under Tanggungan T.12 and supply vote B.11, and the grants by name to the Federal Territories' administrations under B.32 and B.06). Grants paid to a class (the state governments, the local authorities, the Federal Territories' administrations) or to Sabah and Sarawak together are not split in the federal accounts: they carry geo _unallocated and are not divided here. Development grants, federal projects in a state, ministries' payments to state agencies and lines that only name or tag a body without stating it as the recipient are not loaded, so these flows are a floor, not what a state received; what a state records receiving is on its own books, not yet matched.
text_bm: Aliran ialah wang yang ditunjukkan akaun teraudit pembayar berpindah kepada penerima (di sini pemberian persekutuan kepada negeri, PKKP T.12). Pemberian kepada kerajaan negeri atau PBT sebagai satu golongan tidak dipecahkan mengikut negeri dalam akaun persekutuan dan tidak dibahagikan di sini.

applies_when: any state_gov.revenue.federal_* observation or gap_federal_vs_state row
text_en: Federal grant lines in the state accounts are taken from the audit report's revenue tables, which print a grant only when it is among the state's largest revenue items (or, in Sabah and Sarawak, a revenue category); some reports also print one in a table of significant changes, which is not extracted: a state-year without a value means not printed, not zero, and states that print it are not a sample of all states. A later volume can print a different figure for the same year, and later columns have been found misaligned on the page: the view lists every printing but compares only the state's own report.
text_bm: Baris pemberian persekutuan dalam akaun negeri diambil daripada jadual hasil laporan audit, yang mencetak sesuatu pemberian hanya jika ia antara lima hasil terbesar negeri: tahun tanpa nilai bermaksud tidak dicetak, bukan sifar.

applies_when: any gap_federal_placement row or fact_placement row
text_en: Federal money is placed in a state only where the federal accounts name the place: a development project whose name names one state, districts of one state, or a listed town or region (meta/place_gazetteer.csv), or a grant to a named state government or territory administration, and from FY2019 the class grants at MOF's own record of what each state was paid (Lampiran E, used only where it adds up to the audited line). The place is where the project is, not who benefits; some placed lines are loans, equity or a regional agency (KEDA, placed in Kedah, also serves Perlis). PKKP splits some programmes into Peninsula, Sabah and Sarawak lines: the Sabah and Sarawak lines are placed and the Peninsula line cannot be (RM4.24b over the years held, reported as 'peninsula'), so Sabah and Sarawak hold about 54% of the placed project money over the years held (42-65% by year), partly because of how the accounts are laid out. Salaries, subsidies, cash transfers and most projects have no place in the federal accounts, so placed_share is small (under 4% of federal spending in every year held) and amounts by state are withheld below 60%; nothing is split by formula.
text_bm: Wang persekutuan diletakkan di sesebuah negeri hanya apabila akaun persekutuan menamakan tempatnya: projek pembangunan yang namanya menyebut satu negeri, daerah dalam satu negeri, atau bandar atau wilayah yang disenaraikan (meta/place_gazetteer.csv), atau pemberian kepada kerajaan negeri atau pentadbiran wilayah yang dinamakan, dan mulai FY2019 pemberian kepada negeri secara kelas mengikut rekod MOF sendiri tentang bayaran kepada setiap negeri (Lampiran E, digunakan hanya apabila jumlahnya sama dengan baris yang diaudit). Tempat itu ialah lokasi projek, bukan penerima manfaat; sesetengah baris ialah pinjaman, ekuiti atau agensi wilayah (KEDA, diletakkan di Kedah, juga berkhidmat untuk Perlis). PKKP memecahkan sesetengah program kepada baris Semenanjung, Sabah dan Sarawak: baris Sabah dan Sarawak diletakkan tetapi baris Semenanjung tidak boleh (RM4.24b bagi tahun yang dipegang, dilaporkan sebagai 'peninsula'), maka Sabah dan Sarawak memegang kira-kira 54% wang projek yang diletakkan bagi tahun yang dipegang (42-65% mengikut tahun), sebahagiannya kerana susunan akaun. Emolumen, subsidi, pemindahan tunai dan kebanyakan projek tidak mempunyai tempat dalam akaun persekutuan, maka placed_share adalah kecil (di bawah 4% setiap tahun) dan jumlah mengikut negeri tidak diterbitkan di bawah 60%; tiada pembahagian mengikut formula.

applies_when: any gap_federal_vs_state or gap_federal_placement row that uses Lampiran E (federal_by_state_rm, by_state_status, grants_split_by_payer_rm)
text_en: federal_by_state_rm and grants_split_by_payer_rm are MOF's own record of what each state was paid (the Budget book's Lampiran E, FY2019-2024), not the audited accounts, which pay these grants to the states as a class. They are used only for a grant and year whose national total equals the audited line within RM2 (D30); that test cannot check how MOF split the total between states (several states' figures are round hundreds or repeat the previous year's amount).
text_bm: federal_by_state_rm dan grants_split_by_payer_rm ialah rekod MOF sendiri tentang bayaran kepada setiap negeri (Lampiran E buku Belanjawan, FY2019-2024), bukan akaun yang diaudit, yang membayar pemberian ini kepada negeri-negeri secara kelas. Ia digunakan hanya bagi pemberian dan tahun yang jumlah nasionalnya sama dengan baris yang diaudit dalam lingkungan RM2 (D30); ujian itu tidak dapat menyemak cara MOF membahagikan jumlah itu antara negeri (angka beberapa negeri ialah ratusan genap atau mengulang amaun tahun sebelumnya).

applies_when: the edition is an Anggaran Hasil (Budget revenue) book and the period is before the book's year
text_en: A past year's revenue as reprinted in a Budget revenue book (MOF), not as audited: the book prints the actual two years back and the revised estimate of the year before. The Auditor-General's figure for the same year is in PKKP (basis audited); where they differ, both are kept as published (FY2024: the book is RM144 below the audit, in non-revenue receipts).
text_bm: Hasil tahun lalu seperti dicetak semula dalam buku Anggaran Hasil (MOF), bukan seperti diaudit. Angka Ketua Audit Negara bagi tahun yang sama ada dalam PKKP (asas audited); jika berbeza, kedua-duanya disimpan seperti diterbitkan.

applies_when: any gap_obligations_growth row or federal_gov.obligation.* observation
text_en: A position at 31 December in PKKP's memorandum accounts, outside the cash accounts: what the government owes or has guaranteed, not money spent. The instruments overlap and must never be added: the financial commitments include the committed guarantees, and the contributor and depositor guarantees overlap deposit insurance. A guarantee is a liability only if the borrower defaults (statutory guarantees) or because the government services the debt (committed guarantees).
text_bm: Kedudukan pada 31 Disember dalam akaun memorandum PKKP, di luar akaun tunai. Instrumen bertindih dan tidak boleh dijumlahkan: komitmen kewangan merangkumi komitmen jaminan, dan jaminan pencarum/pendeposit bertindih dengan insurans deposit.
